coverage_note: Usable response masks include source abundance/QC filters; they are not complete assay gene axes. Own target excluded from no-source count.
scope: Cosine comparisons use the same common predictor-supported gene mask for matched and permuted targets in each context; unsupported contrasts abstain. Retrospective development diagnostic, previously inspected public source summaries. Entire evaluated family excluded. Normal-q source proxy, not count-level official metric. Ungated V11 estimator; no challenge-context gene-abundance gate. Heuristic intervals are not posterior credible intervals. Centered truth used only to calculate diagnostic metrics. No model selected or fitted for submission.
